notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixes for translations not appearing
Fixed cursor disappearing from popups
Changed tutorial rewards

notes.title: Guide system update
notes.content:
The guide system has been updated.

User Feedback

It is difficult for first-time users to understand the game.
Difficult to upgrade to sector 2.
It is not easy to recognize the effectiveness of evaluation resources (hope, administration, education).


Guide system

Guide to the synergy system between buildings, which is the core system of the game.
Evaluation resources are provided as guide compensation.
When upgrading to Sector 2, the necessary resources are provided as a reward.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
bug fix
  - Fixed an issue where the mouse did not work on objects located at specific locations in the UI.
  - Modification of quest shortcut key display
  - Fixed an issue where the time required for research was incorrect.
  - Fixed an issue where technology could not be upgraded when continuing
  - Fixed an issue where the notification window did not turn off when paused
  - Modified the wave bar to be reset when the battle wave ends.
  - Fixed an issue where tiles were pressed after moving the screen
  - Fixed an issue where preferences were not saved
  - Fixed an issue where the sound volume value was not saved in the restart option.

system update
  - Changed looter bullets
  - Apply and improve looter bullet game pooling
  - Enhanced object pooling
  - Delete unnecessary files
  - Added volume control at first startup
  - Localization work (added English translation)
  - Added a function to fix the camera when a pop-up is created
  - Modified the synergy panel and tile menu positions to change depending on the mouse position.
  - Added warning notification when looters invade
  - Added function to check building synergy of nearby tiles during construction
  - Added laser turret hit effect
  - Added a function to check how many synergies have been completed in structure information
  - Improved UI bar to move a little more smoothly
  - Added new quest notifications
  - Added the ability to unlock tiles with one click
  - Improved settings pop-up UI

Balance fixes
  - Modified to make it easier to progress from tier 3 sector to tier 5 sector.
  - Increased overall research effectiveness
  - Modified to maximize the synergy effect between terrain and buildings.

If you find any additional bugs or have any comments,
Please send an email to eastvillage@eastvill.com and we will edit it.
